name: TightenStopToEntryBarIfStrong
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge((double)ctx.BarsSinceEntry(), 1.0) && el_gt(entryBarClose, entryBarOpen) && el_ge(entryBarClose - entryBarOpen, strongBodyFrac * (entryBarHigh - entryBarLow)) && el_le(close[0], entryBarLow - stopOffset)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge((double)ctx.BarsSinceEntry(), 1.0) && el_lt(entryBarClose, entryBarOpen) && el_ge(entryBarOpen - entryBarClose, strongBodyFrac * (entryBarHigh - entryBarLow)) && el_ge(close[0], entryBarHigh + stopOffset)
